create_EMAHook_default: create an EMAHook with default momentum 0.0002 to apply exponential moving average on model parameters during training
create_EMAHook_custom_momentum: create an EMAHook with custom momentum interval and warm_up steps for fine-tuned parameter averaging
create_EMAHook_resume: create an EMAHook that resumes training from a checkpoint path with existing EMA parameters
review_EMAHook_swap: review the EMAHook _swap_ema_parameters method that swaps model parameters with EMA buffer before evaluation
review_EMAHook_warmup: review the EMAHook warm_up momentum schedule that gradually increases momentum during initial training steps
